answer: By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the fable of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the summit re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
